LAYER_1_ARGMAX_PER_POLE.argmax_upward_bias: An argmax over 7 noisy cells is partly the luckiest cell. Neither argmax win rate is quoted without its runner-up contrast and indistinguishable set below.

pole_A.S2_third_ranked: 6A_0D and 3A_3D tie at 0.75 for third; both shown, both +0.0938 [-0.0469, +0.2344], both include zero
pole_A.reading: Pole A has NO distinguishable winner. 4A_2D is tied with 5A_1D, 6A_0D and 3A_3D. Pole A is a plateau from 3 to 6 attackers (0.75 to 0.84) that falls off at 2A_4D (0.594) and collapses at 1A_5D and 0A_6D.

pole_B.reading: Pole B has a clear TOP PAIR, 6A_0D and 5A_1D, which are tied with each other and separate cleanly from everything else. The landscape is monotone: fewer defenders is better, with a sharp break between 5A_1D (0.81) and 4A_2D (0.36).

LAYER_3_SHAPE_AND_THE_PREDECLARED_DIRECT.detail: Pole B's argmax has 0 defenders and Pole A's has 2, which meets the addendum's predeclared definition and matches the 4v4 direction.
LAYER_3_SHAPE_AND_THE_PREDECLARED_DIRECT.but_the_A_side_is_weak: Pole A's argmax is tied with three others, so 'A's argmax has 2 defenders' is not a distinguishable fact. What is distinguishable on A is only that 0A_6D, 1A_5D and (marginally) 2A_4D are worse.

sealed_contrasts_vs_3A_3D.reading: On Pole B, every attack-heavy composition separates from the balanced 3A_3D baseline, by up to +0.80. On Pole A, no attack-heavy composition separates from it. The A-side evidence that composition matters is only in the defence-heavy direction.

LAYER_3_SHAPE_AND_THE_PREDECLARED_DIRECT.sealed_regime_signal_check: Not met. The only composition with opposite signs, 6A_0D, has an A mean of exactly 0.0, which the sign test scores as 'not greater than zero', and its A interval includes zero. That 'opposite_sign: true' entry is a zero-mean artifact, not an A-side effect.

THE_WRINKLE_THAT_BEARS_ON_THE_PREDECLARE.finding: The compositions statistically as good as each pole's best, intersected across poles, are 6A_0D and 5A_1D. A single fixed attack-heavy composition is indistinguishable from the per-pole argmax on BOTH poles.

point_estimates_of_what_routing_could_ad.both_upward_biased: Each argmax was selected on the same data it is being compared on, so both gains are overstated. Both intervals include zero.
point_estimates_of_what_routing_could_ad.mean_across_poles: 5A_1D 0.8203 and 6A_0D 0.8203, an exact tie; the per-pole-argmax pair averages 0.8672. That 0.047 is upward-biased and not separated from noise.

score_margin_descriptive_no_intervals.reading: On Pole A, 6A_0D wins about as often as 3A_3D but by far less (0.81 against 1.67), while 5A_1D has the best A margin (2.11) and a top-two win rate. On the point estimates 5A_1D is the more robust single composition and 6A_0D pays for all-out attack on margin. No paired margin intervals were computed.

THE_WRINKLE_THAT_BEARS_ON_THE_PREDECLARE.why_this_matters: The 4v4 router exists because a fixed all-attack composition HURT Pole A (4A_0D cost A win rate) while helping B. At 6v6 under these certified poles that trade-off is not visible: an attack-heavy fixed composition costs A nothing detectable. That is a difference between the two scales' results, and it carries the frozen Pole-B clause: it could be team size, opponent construction, or their interaction.

what_this_does_and_does_not_say_about_th.the_letter_of_the_predeclared_branch: A clear B-heavy composition pattern is present, so by the letter of the branch a 6v6 routed-composition freeze is licensed.
what_this_does_and_does_not_say_about_th.the_substantive_concern: A router presupposes that per-regime best compositions differ enough to be worth switching between. Here a fixed composition is tied with the best on both poles, so the router's incremental value over that fixed composition is small on the point estimates and undemonstrated on the intervals.
what_this_does_and_does_not_say_about_th.the_addendum_flat_branch_facts: Pole A's argmax does not separate from the 3A_3D baseline, which the spec names as evidence for the flat branch; Pole B's does, decisively. Neither argmax separates from its runner-up.
what_this_does_and_does_not_say_about_th.the_judgement_is_the_PIs: Which reading governs is a PI decision. This record states the facts and does not choose.

WHAT_IS_ESTABLISHED: On the certified 6v6 Pole B, composition is a large lever: the balanced 3A_3D wins 9% of episodes, while 6A_0D and 5A_1D win 89% and 81%. The attack-heavy advantage over the baseline is +0.80 and +0.72, both intervals well clear of zero, consistent across both seed halves.
On the certified 6v6 Pole A, composition matters only at the defence-heavy end: 1A_5D and 0A_6D are clearly worse than the baseline, and among 3 to 6 attackers nothing is distinguishable at n=64.
A single fixed 5A_1D or 6A_0D is statistically indistinguishable from the per-pole best on both poles.
WHAT_IS_NOT_ESTABLISHED: That any composition is the winner on Pole A. The argmax is tied with three others.
That routing between compositions would beat a fixed 5A_1D at 6v6. It is undemonstrated and, on the point estimates, small.
Any attribution of a 4v4-versus-6v6 difference to team size. The frozen boundary forbids it: Pole B differs in construction across the two scales.
Anything about learned coordination, PPO, or the guarded router transferring to 6v6.

OPEN_DECISIONS_FOR_THE_PI_NONE_STARTED.note: The frozen spec authorizes the sweep only. Nothing below is started.
OPEN_DECISIONS_FOR_THE_PI_NONE_STARTED.option_1_fixed_composition_confirmation: Freeze a fresh-seed 6v6 test of ONE fixed attack-heavy composition against the 3A_3D baseline on both certified poles, with the B-improvement and A-harm gates used at 4v4. It tests what the data actually supports and is cheap. The composition must be chosen by a mechanical rule declared in advance. 5A_1D and 6A_0D tie exactly on mean win rate across poles (0.8203); worst-pole win rate breaks the tie toward 5A_1D (0.8125 against 0.75), and a maximin rule is one natural choice.
OPEN_DECISIONS_FOR_THE_PI_NONE_STARTED.option_2_routed_experiment: Freeze a 6v6 routed-composition experiment as the branch's letter allows. Its comparator must be the best fixed composition, not the 3A_3D baseline, and the plausible gain is small, so it would be hard to detect.
OPEN_DECISIONS_FOR_THE_PI_NONE_STARTED.option_3_stop_the_composition_line_at_6v: Record the attack-heavy prior and use it as the target structure for learned coordination, on the reading that composition at 6v6 under these poles is 'send almost everyone to attack'.
OPEN_DECISIONS_FOR_THE_PI_NONE_STARTED.not_offered: Raising n to resolve Pole A, or adding compositions. The frozen branch forbids both.
